question: Does energy-based learning of reusable edge-reliability constraints from supervised small graph demonstrations improve recovery of previously unobserved node relations on cold, unseen graph sizes and an unseen graph topology against matched conventional supervised controls?
hypothesis: A three-weight structured-energy max-margin learner trained only on earlier graph demonstrations will cold-transfer more accurate binary relationships to disjoint 36/52-node graph worlds than Bayes, logistic, uniform or sham controls, while preserving the old domain and whole-process compute efficiency.
predecessor: ENERGY-41 INVALID at ed1d67984413e438a941efed3a6029b8f02d07c5: frozen structured feature d_g wrongly equaled negative of true violated-energy contrast V(flip)-V(truth), 2,217 nonzero mismatch checks. New experiment fixes only this sign, adds semantic auditor and uses disjoint seeds.

dataset.kind: Synthetic SHA256-keyed ring-connected frustrated XOR2 constraint graph demonstrations, source generated by pinned code; no real user data, no protected scientific first-use or restricted dataset
dataset.license: Self-authored synthetic method and generated cases
dataset.preprocessed: Group edge pair by cyclic node distance: ring=group0, distance2..4=group1, other=group2; observed XOR parity corrupted independently by group
dataset.data_leakage: Ground-truth node assignments available only during supervised TRAIN demonstrations and held-out SCORING. Only edge list with observed XOR and group ID is available to each evaluation learner/inference engine.
dataset.note: The oracle-only diagnostic uses these probabilities; all matched learned methods infer group structure solely from training demonstrations. The 3-class structural grouping is authored, not autonomously discovered.

frozen_design.smoke_status: PASS 23,762 independent checks including 960 direct XOR flip-vs-original signed-group contrast invariants, 16 test and 16 train worlds, excluded seed 99773. Primary seeds not tested at freeze.

training.observations_per_graph: 3*n=60 noisy XOR edges, PLUS complete true binary assignment exposed as a supervision demonstration on TRAIN ONLY

frozen_design.unseen_family: lattice; zero supervised lattice worlds in train
frozen_design.non_information_matched_diagnostic: oracle knows exact synthetic group corruption probabilities; report separately but exclude from stronger training matched comparator
frozen_design.model_fit: Energy group-positive projected three-parameter structured hinge learning using per-train-demo 20 one-node-flip contrastive examples with verified d_g=V_g(flip)-V_g(truth) (not inverse), margin=2, 96 epochs, lr=0.06, L2=0.01, normalized group weights sum=3. Bayes Beta(1,1) group error frequencies then log reliability odds, 3 parameters. Conventional logistic fit_intercept=False C=1 max_iter=1000 tol=1e-9 and group one-hot labels, 3 parameters. Uniform unit weights. Shuffled_energy contrastive fit on deterministically permuted group metadata on each training graph. Oracle true group log reliability odds, unavailable to candidate/controls.
frozen_design.inference: Every arm uses exactly the same deterministic 8-start, 24-sweep seeded iterated greedy local-search engine on weighted XOR violations with 10% perturbation every 8 sweeps. Same graph/initial random streams/proposals, but differing fitted weights can alter dynamic states. All weights fixed after training within each seed, no adaptation or withheld labels at evaluation.
frozen_design.evaluator: For each held world, select 40 hash-ranked node pairs disjoint from all observed graph edges. Predict XOR(node_i,node_j) from inferred binary states; score exact agreement with hidden true XOR gauge-invariant relationship. Total 1440 novel, 480 old, 480 unseen lattice, 720 n52. Report arm weight vectors, per-case bits, per-case scores and per-seed outcomes. No ground truth presented to any test model.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Three independent seed cohorts, 16 train +16 test worlds per cohort. One frozen primary; one exact-source semantic replay and one independent audit. No postscore hyperparameter tuning or extra seeds. All local CPU Python 3.13.5 NumPy 2.3.5 sklearn 1.8.0, BLAS threads 1; no GPU/API.
frozen_design.time: Per-arm policy total = all train source-generation wall + model fitting wall + all held world generation wall + inference wall. Since graph generation is shared, it is charged per policy identically. Not actual physical Joules/controlled whole workstation cost; include experiment and audit wall separately. Nondeterministic timings excluded from canonical semantic replay.

metrics: Exact held disjoint pair relation accuracy overall novel, cold old, unseen lattice, n52
Per-seed margin over strongest matched control
Learned 3-factor weight identity and shuffled-control negative
Correct novel relations per aggregated measured training plus generation plus inference wall second
Number of successful independent source and inference audit checks

frozen_gates.novel_vs_best_information_matched_2pp: Structured energy novel correct >= best Bayes/logistic/uniform/shuffled energy correct +2pp of 1440.
frozen_gates.novel_vs_uniform_3pp: Structured energy novel correct >= uniform correct +3pp of 1440.
frozen_gates.old_retention_at_most_1pp_loss: Structured energy old correct no more than 1pp of 480 below best matched control.
frozen_gates.group_shuffled_negative_5pp: Structured energy novel correct >= group-shuffled energy trained same-budget novel correct +5pp of 1440.
frozen_gates.unseen_family_vs_bayes_1pp: Structured energy exact novel lattice pair correctness >= empirical Bayes by +1pp of 480.
frozen_gates.n52_vs_bayes_1pp: Structured energy exact novel n52 pair correctness >= empirical Bayes by +1pp of 720.
frozen_gates.seed_stability_two_of_three: Structured energy strict positive novel relation margin over strongest matched control in >=2 of 3 independent seeds.
frozen_gates.end_to_end_value_per_second_1point2x_bay: Structured energy correct novel pair relations per measured policy generation+fit+inference second >=1.2x Bayes yield defined identically.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_GO iff all eight frozen gates PASS and all 3 cohorts and independent audit pass; even then NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native accepted integration.
classification_rules.negative: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO if any gate fails on a valid run. Preserve raw cases; no tuning consumed seeds.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID if output differs from frozen code, train/held overlap, leak of test truth to learners, unequal supervision/model families, missing matched controls, independent audit failure, protocol altered after primary or shifted source SHA. Distinguish repository atlas CI from science. Added hard invalid trigger: signed-contrastive invariant fails on any training graph.
classification_rules.mixed: Report 8 gates individually and retain unfavorable outcomes; no subset-based headline rescue.

prohibited_after_primary_run: Do not change model hyperparameters, threshold, seeds or graph families
No additional primary tests except unchanged-source semantic replay
No test truth or query leak to any learner
